feeds.title: Diary of a Journal Planner » Bullet Journal
feeds.description: We Believe that journaling helps you gain the clarity you need to focus on what really matters in your life. Diary of a Journal Planner is a site designed for sharing bullet journal tutorials, planning and productivity tools, art journaling, and doodle inspiration.

feeds.title: Life is Messy and Brilliant
feeds.description: Hello, There! My name is Jenniffer and I am the creative blogger + digital artist of Life is Messy and Brilliant. I started my blog in 2017 when I was a senior in college. I was studying Biomedical Sciences but there was a part of me that was craving art. One day I sat down in my office chair, opened my computer, and started to create printables in Microsoft Word and Keynote. Two years, I completed my bachelor's degree and my blog gained attention for its girly printables, digital planner tutorials, and college tips.

feeds.title: Rediscover Analog
feeds.description: Rediscover Analog was launched in 2018 to serve as a platform for analog lovers to share how they organize their lives through Bullet Journaling, how they communicate with others through writing with fountain pens, and how they capture memories through film photography.

feeds.title: Bullet Journal | The Bullet Journalist
feeds.description: All things Bullet Journal, productivity, and simplicity. Tips, tricks, interviews, and community examples about how to live an intentional life. Meet the analog method for the digital age that will help you track the past, order the present, and design your future.

feeds.title: The Petite Planner
feeds.description: Ready to start your first bullet journal or learn how to doodle? We have everything from beginner guides and printables to more advanced drawing tutorials. Let's be more creative, more productive, and get on the path to living your best life!

feeds.title: NotebookTherapy Blog
feeds.description: Articles on planning, organizing, journaling, creativity and bullet journaling. Notebook Therapy holds a lot close to our hearts, but mostly, we want to create a space for everyone to feel more creative and at peace. With every product, we aim to bring you a sense of joy and calm; one you can access in both your brightest moments and your darkest.

feeds.title: Archer and Olive » Bullet Journal
feeds.description: At Archer & Olive, we create handcrafted journals and planners that help you plan your days with intention, improve your mental health, and carve time out for creativity.

feeds.title: Space + Quiet
feeds.description: Whether you just want ideas for decorating your planner or to create a whole kick-ass organization system that will get you on track to happiness, you're in the right place! I'm guessing, since you're here right now, that you LOVE your paper planner, thrive when organized, and get a little giddy in a stationery shop.

feeds.title: All About Planners » Bullet Journal
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Rachael, a 20-something Aussie addicted to all things planning. From stickers to pens, planner accessories, planner DIY's and everything else in between. I blog about different ways to plan, planner reviews, printables, planner stickers, pens and graphic design. This section features articles on bullet journals.

feeds.title: Stationery Pal Blog
feeds.description: We share tips and news on bullet journals, planners, and stationery on this blog. We can learn from each other here, making our journal better. Come and join us, let's create an excellent community for people who love writing. Stationery Pal is an online store and community for stationery, planner addict, bullet journal (Bujo) lover.

feeds.title: Masha Plans
feeds.description: Welcome to Masha Plans, where we build a happy, productive, and purposeful life while being creative at the same time with the help of Bullet Journaling.

feeds.title: Journal With Purpose Blog
feeds.description: I'm Helen, I have a bit of a thing about journals. I use journals to plan out my dream life, document special moments and keep a record of the day to day happenings in my life. There will be plenty of blog posts to show you what I'm up to, along with tutorials, training courses and downloads to give you lots of new ideas.

feeds.title: Simple Life of a Lady » Bullet Journal
feeds.description: Hello Beautiful! I'm Em, and let me personally welcome you to Simple Life of a Lady! I'm so thrilled you're here! This blog was created to help you simplify and focus on what really matters in your life. I've always loved simplicity but it was always hard for me to be in order. Whether it was because of a lot of paper works (I was a teacher), or too many reports approaching a deadline (I was an accountant too), getting organized has never been my thing.

feeds.title: AnjaHome
feeds.description: My name is Anna and I am the face behind the blog Anja Home, where I share my love and passion for bullet journaling, DIY projects, and organization. I started AnjaHome in April 2018 after I discovered the bullet journal system. to be a better, happier, and more organized person. Now I want to help you to achieve your goals, fulfill dreams, and live a happy life.

feeds.title: Sheena of the Journal
feeds.description: I'm a Bullet Journal enthusiast, mother of three rugrats, and introvert extraordinaire. Here, I'll be talking about better ways to organize your family and yourself, one journal page at a time.

feeds.title: LittleCoffeeFox | Inspiration Through Organization
feeds.description: Organization is key, and I use my bullet journal to build structure, plan, and change my life for the better and I'm here to help you do the same. I'm all about planners, lettering, & other creativity!

feeds.title: Little Miss Rose » Bullet Journal
feeds.description: Bullet Journal Inspiration for Your Creative Life. Little Miss Rose is full of tutorials, ideas, and inspiration for your bullet journal. There's something for everyone at all levels!

feeds.title: Tombow USA » Bullet Journal
feeds.description: At Tombow, we're passionate about offering the finest and most innovative executive pens, office, arts and crafts products on the market today. The section features articles on planning, bullet journaling, to-do lists and more!

feeds.title: Rae's Daily Page » Bullet Journal
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Rae, and welcome to Rae's Daily Page! I'm a twenty-something cat & dog mom, wife, financial analyst, and bullet journal enthusiast. My love for stationery goes back as long as I can remember. I've always had an unhealthy obsession with notebooks, stickers, and pens, and bullet journaling gave me a productive use for them. I've been bullet journaling for over two years and I am in my third bullet journal. I love experimenting with different styles and themes. You can expect to see monthly spreads, page ideas, doodle tutorials, and stationery reviews.

feeds.title: Caitlin Da Silva Blog
feeds.description: My name is Caitlin Da Silva and I'm a 23 year-old Canadian content creator living in Toronto! My goal with my content since I started my blog back in 2016 is to encourage my audience to keep themselves on the top of their to-do list, while also documenting the ups and downs of figuring life out in your twenties (because let's be real, there's many)!

feeds.title: Tiny Ray of Sunshine
feeds.description: A blog about the Bullet Journal, planning, productivity, and other creative adventures. Sharing ideas, tips, and insight on the Bullet Journal, planning, productivity, and creative pursuits.

feeds.title: Slightly Sorted » Bullet Journals
feeds.description: Loads of information on bullet journals! Bullet journals have become a huge THING! And with good reason - if you've not started one yet, prepare to become seriously addicted! The posts here will help you to discover loads of clever bullet journal hacks, ideas for bullet journal collections, the best bullet journal supplies.. and lots more!

feeds.title: Planning Mindfully » Bullet Journal
feeds.description: Designing Life with Intention. Everything bullet journal! Learn how to set up your bullet journal layouts, fix problems, and master time management. Tons of bullet journal inspiration!

feeds.title: Your Visual Journal » Bullet Journaling
feeds.description: Are you a fan of the bullet journal method? These posts help you take the practice deeper by connecting you to resources and inspiration.

feeds.title: Kerrymay Makes » Bullet-journaling
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kerry a Notts UK blogger, planner, art & creative journal fanatic. I've been part of the planner and art journal world now since 2016 and I have loved every minute of it.

feeds.title: Wellella | Bullet Journal Ideas & Planner Printables
feeds.description: Wellella is a blog about helping you live a happier, more organized life! Here we talk a lot about bullet journaling, planning, and how to be more productive.

feeds.title: Mark Your Pages
feeds.description: I'm Mark. Inspiring others with functional and creative Bullet Journals & having reel fun along the way.

feeds.title: Life by Whitney
feeds.description: Follow along on my blog for amazing journaling inspiration to help you live a more productive life. It's never too late to get started.
